services.desc: Come Cruise with Cruisin' Tikis Pittsburgh! Now Available! Experience a scenic 2-hour public sightseeing river cruise in Pittsburgh! Whether you're visiting or just looking for a fun way to enjoy the city, this cruise is a must. Relax on a tiki boat while taking in stunning views of Pittsburgh’s iconic landmarks and capturing incredible photo opportunities from the water. Book your spot today!
